name: recruit-callcenter-illustrated-v1

references.role: Approved full visual design and anime art direction

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one wide hero illustration for the existing Japanese TELEMO recruitment website.
Image 1 is the complete approved blue recruitment design and visual/style reference. Image 2 is the user's cropped focus on the four illustrated colleagues; it identifies exactly the scene to transform.
Create a new CALL CENTER VERSION of the upper illustrated hero, retaining the original friendly Japanese anime illustration style, the recognizable identities of the same four young Japanese colleagues, their blue/white/navy clothing, warm smiles, coordinated team composition, strong cobalt/sky-blue palette, bright daylight and office windows with a city skyline.
Output only the upper illustrated hero as one wide landscape image approximately 1505x630 (aspect ratio about 2.39:1). DO NOT include the lower white explanatory-copy section, recruitment CTA, role pills or pale-blue employment-category navigation from image 1; these already exist as functional HTML on the website. No collage, browser or device frame.

Change the scene so it clearly depicts a real call-center team:
- The seated young man on the left wears a professional lightweight single-ear or double-ear COMMUNICATIONS HEADSET ON HIS HEAD, with a slender boom microphone naturally by his mouth, not music headphones around his neck. He is cheerfully speaking with a customer while viewing a customer-contact screen. Replace his code-editor display with a subtle call-center CRM interface containing simple unreadable rows, customer/contact blocks and a small call-status symbol. Do not render legible invented interface text.
- The young woman in front on the right also wears a lightweight boom-microphone headset, working at her computer while warmly smiling toward her teammate and consulting a paper call script.
- The woman at the far right wears a similar headset and holds a tablet or clipboard containing an unreadable customer-support checklist.
- The standing man behind them is an approachable team leader in the same blue blazer, wearing a small single-ear headset, supporting the team with a welcoming open-hand gesture.
- Make the tabletop contain workstations, keyboards, computer monitors or laptops, a small business desk phone with coiled cord, simple call-script sheets and pens. Natural coherent hands and headset cabling. Reduce the prominent programming books and creative-brainstorm props so telephone work is the central visual cue.
- Through the office background show two or three subtle additional rows of call-center workstations with low acoustic dividers and faint small headset-wearing operators. Keep them quiet and subordinate to the four primary characters; no extra foreground people.
- Preserve sunny sky, city and bright white/blue office atmosphere. Clean and cheerful, no dark cubicle factory or futuristic holograms.

Preserve the full LEFT headline and its brush styling and placement; no clipping. Exact text:
Small upper-left: "RECRUIT" and "採用情報"
Large cobalt hand-painted headline, two lines: "挑戦する仲間を、" / "募集しています。"
Lower-left handwritten note: "AIで、" / "はたらくの未来を" / "もっとおもしろく！"
Upper-right handwritten note: "きっと、" / "できる。" / "いっしょに" / "つくろう！"
Retain the original four small white role speech bubbles at their recognizable positions, with exact labels "エンジニア", "セールス", "AIプランナー", "コーポレート". The right-hand background poster may keep "GOOD TEAM! GOOD FUTURE!". No new slogans or claims.

Maintain the recognizable anime faces, proportions and expressive original linework; don't turn them into photographs or 3D figures. Every headset must have a natural fit and correctly attached microphone boom. The scene must read as human telephone sales/customer service teamwork immediately. Exactly one opaque final wide image, sharp legible Japanese lettering, no watermark.
